support, assesses relevance, and guides further
inspection. Independent source judgments run

autonomous research illustrated in Figure 1.
System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates
findings. Jev (Almeida, 2026) serves as System
One, guiding source selection, passage localiza-
tion, and continued reading; proactive discovery
inspects additional candidates. Selected original
passages return to System Two, connecting these
local decisions to the next research action and the
final answer or ranking.
Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and Neu-
CLIRBench (Chen et al., 2026; Lawrie et al.,
2025) cover fixed-corpus question answering and
document ranking. Figure 2 shows that JevGPT
achieves leading task performance at lower cost
than comparably effective research agents. JevGPT
also completes research faster. Evidence analysis
and an ablation study examine how the architecture
turns retrieved sources into useful evidence and
how its components affect task performance.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Final outcomes are measured against held-out gold answers and official relevance judgments outside the model loop.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Official BrowseComp-Plus grading templates and NeuCLIRBench human relevance judgments establish the headline accuracy and nDCG/F1 outcomes.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: System One thresholds and System Two prompts are configured heuristically, with no reported training, tuning, or selection loop against the evaluation benchmarks.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding superior task performance, lower API cost, and reduced overall latency compared to comparably effective deep research agents are well-supported by experimental metrics across both benchmark suites.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluations on BrowseComp-Plus (830 questions) and NeuCLIRBench (105 topics) benchmark against prominent agentic and retrieval baselines under standardized time and compute budgets, supported by thorough ablations and multi-model variations demonstrating consistent efficiency and quality gains.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Task evaluation relies on held-out gold benchmark answers and human-annotated relevance judgments completely outside the model loop.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard benchmark ground truth labels via official BrowseComp-Plus QA grading templates and NeuCLIRBench official relevance judgments (nDCG@20 and F1@20).
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: System Two prompts and System One scoring thresholds (such as relevance probability cutoffs and block localization probabilities) configured heuristically without iterative model training on the evaluation benchmarks.

primary.limitations: The manuscript acknowledges limitations regarding the architecture-level modular split rather than end-to-end unified training, and notes that evaluation is restricted to fixed corpora rather than open-web settings.
primary.method_assessment: The architecture cleanly separates deliberative planning and query reformulation from localized evidence verification, relevance scoring, and proactive candidate discovery, with clear formalizations and parameter specifications for both QA and ranking settings.
primary.quality_rationale: The work presents a well-motivated architectural paradigm, detailed implementation and evaluation protocols, rigorous baseline comparisons, and insightful ablation studies demonstrating genuine efficiency and performance benefits.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces JevGPT, a dual-system autonomous research architecture combining high-level research planning (System Two, powered by large LLMs) with bounded, fast local evidence assessment and reading (System One, powered by Jev), evaluating it on QA and document ranking benchmarks.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The work presents a well-motivated architectural paradigm, detailed implementation and evaluation protocols, rigorous baseline comparisons, and insightful ablation studies demonstrating genuine efficiency and performance benefits.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The manuscript acknowledges limitations regarding the architecture-level modular split rather than end-to-end unified training, and notes that evaluation is restricted to fixed corpora rather than open-web settings.
